i.norm: Tests that calling previous() after next() returns the same token. A TSV tokenizer with no tab characters treats the entire input as a single token. After advancing forward with next() and then going back with previous(), the returned token should be the original input string. The initial previousIndex() should be -1 (before any element).
Before any iteration, previousIndex() returns -1 (cursor is before the first element)
Advance forward past the first (and only) token
Going back one step should return the single token, which equals the entire input
